REGULATION II OF 1974
REGULATION II OF 1974
BALUCHISTAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ACT (EXTENSION TO THE
TRIBAL AREAS OF
BALUCHISTAN) REGULATION, 1974
1. Short title, extent and commencement.-(1) This
Regulation may be called the Baluchistan Development Authority Act (Extension
to the Triba' Areas of Baluchistan) Regulation, 1974.
(2) It extends to the whole of the tribal areas of the
Province of Baluchistan.
(3) It shall be deemed to have come into force on the
14th January, 1974.

REGULATION II OF 1974
REGULATION II OF 1974
BALUCHISTAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ACT (EXTENSION TO THE
TRIBAL AREAS OF
BALUCHISTAN) REGULATION, 1974
2. Extension of Baluchistan Development Authority Act,
1974, to the triba areas of Baluchistan.-The provisions of the Baluchistan
Development Authority Act, 1974 (Baluchistan Act No. X of 1974), and the rules
made thereunder shall apply to the whole of the tribal areas of the Province of
Baluchistan as they apply to the other areas of the Province.
